articles.summary: Truework's cascade completes about three in four verifications and leaves the hard, small-employer cases to thin manual fallback. This guide ranks the six best Truework alternatives — The Work Number, Superunit, Truv, Argyle, Payscore, and InformData — across coverage, fallback behavior, audit trail, and pricing fit.
articles.title: The 6 Best Truework Alternatives for CRAs and Lenders (2026)

articles.summary: Employment verification confirms a candidate's work history against official employer records. This guide covers the three verification methods — database lookup, manual outreach, and AI-automated outreach — with turnaround benchmarks, FCRA requirements, and when to outsource versus verify in-house.
articles.title: What Is Employment Verification? A Complete Guide

articles.summary: The Work Number returns instant data on enrolled employers but stops at the long tail of small and non-participating companies. This guide ranks the five best alternatives — Truework, Superunit, Argyle, Truv, and InformData — across coverage model, FCRA documentation, turnaround, and cost-per-completion.
articles.title: The 5 Best Alternatives to The Work Number for CRAs and Mortgage Lenders (2026)

articles.summary: Most companies verify employment after the offer — after interviews, reference calls, and negotiation are already spent on unverified resumes. Move it to right after the phone screen and verification becomes an early filter, not a final gate, so a disqualifying finding costs one phone screen, not the whole funnel.
articles.title: Why Moving Employment Verification Earlier in the Hiring Cycle Reduces Bad Hires

articles.summary: Medical canvassing vendors now split into human-only firms and AI-augmented providers, and that split changes how you should weigh turnaround, cost per canvas, and documentation. We rank the 7 best medical canvassing companies for 2026 for workers' comp and insurance SIU teams.
articles.title: The 7 Best Medical Canvassing Companies for Workers' Comp & Insurance SIU (2026)

articles.summary: A medical canvass confirms whether, when, and where a claimant was treated — no PHI, no signed release. This guide covers what a canvass returns, the trigger conditions and lines of business, the canvass types, and how Superunit contacts unlimited facilities in parallel with a roughly 24-hour turnaround.
articles.title: What Is Medical Canvassing? A Guide for Insurance SIU and Claims Teams

articles.summary: Income verification confirms an applicant's earnings from a third-party source. This guide covers the three methods — payroll database lookup, document review, and employer outreach — plus how it differs from employment verification, FCRA and salary-history compliance, and a framework for choosing the right method.
articles.title: What Is Income Verification? A Complete Guide

articles.summary: The Work Number covers only about 40% of U.S. employers, so 'no record found' is a routine result — not an edge case. This is the structured fallback waterfall that completes verification when TWN comes up empty: written VOE, borrower-assisted payroll connection, multi-channel manual outreach, and human escalation.
articles.title: What Happens When The Work Number Can't Verify Your Applicant?

articles.summary: A special investigations unit (SIU) is the regulated team inside a carrier's claims operation that investigates suspected fraud. This guide covers what an SIU is, how claims get referred, the core investigation methods, how state regulators audit it, and where outreach bottlenecks throughput.
articles.title: What Is a Special Investigations Unit (SIU)? How Insurance Fraud Investigation Works

articles.summary: Real-time AI overlays, deepfake video, and proxy interviewers let candidates fake their way through video interviews — the performance you evaluate may not belong to the person you hire. Detection is a losing arms race; the fix is verifying employment in parallel with interviews, not after the offer.
articles.title: Why You Can't Trust the Video Interview Anymore

articles.summary: A canvass confirms whether and where treatment happened and needs no HIPAA release; records retrieval pulls the actual charts and requires a signed authorization; an IME adds an independent physician's opinion when causation is contested. Run them in that order — canvass, retrieve, then examine.
articles.title: Medical Canvassing vs. Records Retrieval vs. IME: Which Comes First and Why

AI made resume fraud cheap and high-volume. The fix isn't harder screening; it's authenticating candidates earlier in the cycle.
articles.title: Why Your Hiring Process Can't Catch AI Resume Fraud
